motivation: Test whether cross-asset information and a broader historically formed liquid universe produce economically useful edge that is absent from BTC/ETH/SOL directional candle forecasting. This is independent of the observed carry replication and does not modify Trial 1 or Trial 2.
dataSource: checksum-verified Binance Vision public spot archives

universeFormation.postFormationDataFirewall: No 2023-or-later price/return data may be downloaded or inspected for Trial 3 until the formed universe membership and source hashes are committed on the research branch.
universeFormation.candidatePrefixes: enumerate every historical symbol prefix under data/spot/monthly/klines/ from the official Binance public-data bucket; do not begin from the current exchangeInfo symbol list
universeFormation.liquidityMeasure: median daily quote-asset volume across all valid 2022 one-day bars
universeFormation.membershipRule: rank eligible symbols descending by the frozen liquidity measure and select exactly the first 30; ties break lexicographically by symbol
universeFormation.sourceIntegrity: each 2022 monthly 1d ZIP used in formation must match its adjacent official .CHECKSUM; missing monthly files are allowed and simply contribute no bars, but no bar may be interpolated

historicalData.membership: the immutable 30-symbol 2022 formation output only; never add later listings even if they become large
historicalData.delistingAndMissingDataRule: an asset with insufficient current history is ineligible. If an already-held asset loses tradeable daily data before a scheduled rebalance, record a forced data/delisting exit using its final observed close before the gap with the frozen sell friction, then keep it ineligible until data resumes. Never replace it with an out-of-universe asset.

decisionSchedule.decisionTime: first available Binance UTC daily open of each calendar month
decisionSchedule.featureCutoff: strictly before the rebalance open; features use daily observations through the previous available UTC day only
decisionSchedule.holdingPeriod: until the next scheduled monthly rebalance unless forced exit by the frozen missing-data rule
decisionSchedule.label: log return from the current rebalance open to the next monthly rebalance open, before trading costs
decisionSchedule.overlap: monthly labels are non-overlapping by construction
decisionSchedule.embargo: one complete monthly rebalance interval between the latest training label and a test/rebalance prediction

features.name: momentum_30d
features.definition: log close return over the prior 30 calendar-day-equivalent daily bars, ending before the rebalance day

features.name: momentum_90d
features.definition: log close return over the prior 90 daily bars, ending before the rebalance day

features.name: realized_vol_30d
features.definition: sample standard deviation of prior 30 daily log returns

features.name: log_median_quote_volume_30d
features.definition: natural log of median daily quote-asset volume over the prior 30 daily bars

features.name: amihud_illiquidity_30d
features.definition: mean absolute daily simple return divided by quote-asset volume over the prior 30 daily bars

features.name: asset_age_log_days
features.definition: natural log of one plus the number of days since the asset's first observed Binance daily bar, using only history available at the rebalance

crossSectionTransform: at each rebalance, winsorize each feature to the 5th/95th percentiles across eligible frozen-universe assets and z-score across that same cross-section; no future dates enter the transform

model.training: expanding monthly pooled panel using only labels whose next-rebalance endpoint occurs before the embargoed prediction month
model.reason: use a low-capacity regularized baseline before tree or neural cross-sectional models; the feature set is intentionally small and economically distinct

portfolio.selectionRule: at each monthly rebalance rank eligible assets by predicted next-month gross return; hold at most the top three whose predicted gross return exceeds that asset's frozen modeled round-trip cost; unallocated capital remains cash
portfolio.turnoverRule: trade only at monthly rebalances or frozen forced exits; unchanged selected assets are resized toward 15% only at rebalance and all buys/sells pay frozen costs

costModel.note: Use the same deliberately conservative TheOldTrader retail friction as prior directional research; do not assume maker execution until E1 independently supports an execution-policy successor.

developmentEvaluation.folds: expanding chronological folds across 2024-01-01 through 2025-12-31 after the 12-month minimum training history

comparators: same-universe 90-day momentum rank top-three monthly baseline with identical position caps/costs
same-universe equal-weight top-three-by-2022-liquidity static buy-and-hold at 45% total exposure
frozen TheOldTrader v2 on BTC/ETH/SOL as a separately labeled directional benchmark where compatible historical data are available

required: final-holdout Sharpe positive and greater than the same-universe 90-day momentum baseline
development walk-forward median candidate Sharpe positive
positive net return in a majority of development folds
candidate total fee drag lower than frozen v2 benchmark when that benchmark is available on the same holdout
no single asset contributes more than 60% of positive realized portfolio profit
at least 10 completed portfolio position exits across development plus final holdout so the result is not one lucky holding
no data-integrity exception, out-of-universe substitution, or post-formation membership change
promotionCriteria.note: Failure of any required criterion blocks promotion. Any change to formation rule, universe size, feature set, ridge lambda, selection count, cost gate, rebalance frequency, dates, or position sizing after final-holdout observation is a new numbered trial.

multipleTesting.selectionAdjustment: report raw Sharpe plus multiple-testing-aware interpretation; compute Deflated Sharpe Ratio when enough independently evaluated alpha candidates exist for a meaningful estimate
